text: My office has received several traffic safety concerns with regards to high volume of cars and traffic jams around Falkirk Street between Old Orchard Grove and Brooke Avenue. To help traffic flow, no parking on the west side of Falkirk Avenue between Old Orchard Grove and Brooke Avenue is being recommended.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Falkirk Street, between Old Orchard Grove and Brooke Avenue.
